data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=uxFsr6yAlHsQ7kNvgG8gbpp&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYACKRpJyxpjN9js5v_0vGWd1ncuKphnqTMKz79pVWmQLA&oe=675AC99C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=_X95h914QnkQ7kNvgGqt-sw&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAFNhHroTWi3_DsyM-60jlKLufAhFxSpH9L9GnHjxysLw&oe=675AD324)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=NtoANQcVgowQ7kNvgE8HrJL&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCAmIiS9opzZk31iIqKOGzuK6w8RTBh87YDK68FgE3f9Q&oe=675ABA87)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=YxVJ3dEB4RwQ7kNvgHYcyzu&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCtRRffnECGKe1UHIPHGkZamAkTH8lVK7wEYqbxzS3UOg&oe=675AAD66)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=eRPg4bSELtkQ7kNvgE_mVoD&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAfL4_01e33DCs8B5d4-4hfFHptL4Hs4Ul8_j0bN0gNNQ&oe=675AD9D8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=kxOxN6tyld8Q7kNvgH5tf6z&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAAov476RjhGIY1_XuMbzrYkKyet1ZIn_VPQPSCTmnbeQ&oe=675AD659)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=oCXjTmTzfFwQ7kNvgGFBa3J&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYARXItrfvl22vjX-DJ5Ysze13MR2FsJQ0MP3ggWvVVo8g&oe=675ABC70)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=_NAbg3Ifmw8Q7kNvgGGQKsh&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYA99xXoUj_mceWymIUxMOB1zlpJf2KkaRUyqXMrXBh0Ew&oe=675ADF2A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=c-U4N54m80EQ7kNvgFi9sKa&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDhkDF90S2i_Ue1pEVre2f86IoYDCSEgmKeJOmB_P7Y5Q&oe=675ABA97)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=fEKNwXd54RcQ7kNvgGyfrxf&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDKNWcNYSEBWgvdzxeWlFIUV1WlAbMs_ySh1bRMPDRqXA&oe=675AD60C)
